units.source_text: “就是因为搞不清楚，才感到难过啊。

en.t: It is precisely because I cannot understand it that it hurts so much.

units.source_text: 你这样说，真让我难受。

en.t: When you say that, it really pains me.

units.source_text: 我怎么想也想不明白，

en.t: No matter how I think about it, I cannot make sense of it,

units.source_text: 不知求过他多少次了，请他告诉我。”

en.t: I cannot tell you how many times I have begged him to tell me.

units.source_text: “先生怎么说？”

en.t: What does Sensei say?

units.source_text: “他老是说‘没什么可告诉你的，你也不必担心什么，我只是变成这个样子了’，不作任何解释。”

en.t: He only ever says, 'There is nothing to tell you, and nothing you need to worry about. I have simply become this way,' and gives no explanation at all.

units.source_text: 我沉默了，夫人也不往下说了。

en.t: I fell silent, and the lady said no more.

units.source_text: 女佣所在的下房里一点儿动静也没有。

en.t: There was not the slightest sound from the maid's room.

units.source_text: 我把小偷的事都给忘了。

en.t: I had completely forgotten about the thief.

units.source_text: “你不认为我有责任吗？”夫人突然问我。

en.t: Do you not think I am responsible? the lady suddenly asked me.

units.source_text: “不。”我答道。

en.t: No, I answered.

units.source_text: “你坦率地说吧。

en.t: Please speak frankly.

units.source_text: 被别人这么看，比杀死我还痛苦。”她又说，

en.t: Being thought of that way is more painful than being killed, she said again,

units.source_text: “我自认为为他做了自己该做的一切。”

en.t: I believe I have done everything I ought to have done for him.

units.source_text: “先生也一直是这么看的，您就放心吧，我可以保证。”

en.t: Sensei has always seen it that way too, so please set your mind at ease. I can assure you of that.

units.source_text: 夫人扒拉平了火盆里的灰，然后把水罐里的水续进水壶，水壶马上不响了。

en.t: The lady smoothed the ashes in the brazier, then poured water from the pitcher into the kettle, and the kettle immediately stopped singing.

units.source_text: “我终于忍受不住，问了先生‘我有什么不对的地方，

en.t: At last I could not bear it any longer, and I asked Sensei, 'If there is something wrong with me,

units.source_text: 你尽管说吧，不要顾虑，能改的我一定改’。

en.t: please tell me without holding back. If it is something I can change, I certainly will.'

units.source_text: 可是先生说‘你哪里有什么错，错全都在我’。

en.t: But Sensei said, 'There is nothing wrong with you. The fault is entirely mine.'

units.source_text: 我伤透了心，哭了起来，

en.t: Hearing that broke my heart, and I began to cry,

units.source_text: 越发想知道自己哪里有过错了。”

en.t: and it only made me want even more to know what was wrong with me.

units.source_text: 夫人的眼睛里满含着泪水。

en.t: The lady's eyes were filled with tears.
